text:
Maya: Quick sync — IntegrateCo kickoff tomorrow. We need a compact handoff that lets sales and SI act without stepping on each other. Thinking a simple 72-hour ownership window + an embargo flag for demo/marketing accounts. Thoughts?
Raj: +1 on simplicity. 72h seems fine for inbound web leads, but field-sourced opportunities need a different beat (longer). Can we add a source-based window?
Sophie: For field-sourced (AE intro) please make it 7 days. AEs often need time to qualify before handing off to SI. 72h is fine for marketplace/gated leads.
Leah: From SI perspective we care about two things: (1) canonical account mapping (CRM id + domain + territory owner) and (2) a soft-exclusion flag for accounts where the SI has preexisting contract work. Both are lightweight.
Tony: +1 to Leah. Also require a "demo-reserved" boolean so we don't schedule partner-led demos for customer-chosen POCs.
Maya: Cool. Proposal: ownership_window = { "marketplace": 72h, "web_inbound": 72h, "ae_introduced": 168h } and fields: crm_id, domain, territory, demo_reserved, embargoed_until, si_existing_contract. I'll paste a compact CSV header we can standardize.
Maya: ```
crm_id,account_name,domain,lead_source,owner,ownership_window_hours,demo_reserved,embargoed_until,si_existing_contract,notes
```
Raj: That CSV looks good. Can integrations-bot auto-populate embargoed_until when we set embargo_reason? Example: embargo_reason=joint_announce -> embargoed_until = announce_date + 14 days.
integrations-bot: Yes — I can set embargoed_until when embargo_reason is provided. Use tag: embargo_reason=joint_announce or embargo_reason=legal_review.
Sophie: For joint announcements we also need a single point of contact (partner_coc) and a short playbook link. Otherwise we get email ping-pong.
Maya: Agreed. Add partner_coc_email and public_announce_date to the schema. For announce scheduling, default embargo window = 14 days post announce.
Leah: Question on handoff mechanics: who books the initial technical scoping call? If AE retains ownership for 7 days, do we require AE to schedule or can SI propose? Need clarity.
Tony: Sales prefers AE books initial 1:1 in that week. If AE doesn't within 72h of converting, SI can step in and propose. That prevents stalled deals.
Maya: So rule: AE_intro ownership window = 168h; within first 72h AE must book scoping call. If not booked, system sends automated nudge and SI gains scheduling permission. 
Raj: We should encode that as two flags: ae_must_schedule_by (timestamp) and si_can_schedule_after (timestamp). integrations-bot can enforce.
Maya: integrations-bot, can you implement the two-flag enforcement and email nudges?
integrations-bot: Implemented as feature request. ETA: 3 business days to prototype. Will post PR link.
Sophie: For mapping edge cases: what about accounts with multiple territories (global accounts)? We need an overlap resolution — prefer the higher-touch SLA owner or use a territory priority field.
Leah: Agree. Let's add territory_priority (numeric) to CSV. Higher number wins. Also add "global_account" boolean and a fallback owner list.
Maya: Great. Final checklist before kickoff: CSV schema we agreed, ownership windows per source, embargo_reason + embargoed_until logic, demo_reserved flag, partner_coc_email, public_announce_date, AE scheduling SLA (72h), bot enforcement, territory_priority fallback. Anyone object?
Tony: No objections. Can we add a quick SLX (sales + SI exchange) template for the first email so we don't craft each time?
Maya: I'll draft a 2-line template in the doc repo and post link.
Raj: Also capture in the handoff sheet: lead_score and product_vertical so SI can prep domain-specific assets.
Maya: Noted. Adding lead_score and product_vertical.
Sophie: One last ask: can we gate marketing demos for hardware-partner bundled deals? If hardware is involved, marketing needs extra legal review — add embargo_reason=hw_bundle.
Leah: Good catch. We'll add a hw_bundle flag and set embargo default to 21 days for hardware-bundled announcements.
Maya: Perfect. I'll update the CSV header and push a final one-pager in the partnership drive. integration-bot please create a quick sanity check webhook to reject malformed CSVs (missing crm_id or domain).
integrations-bot: Will add validation: crm_id and domain required. Rejection message will include row number and missing fields.
Tony: Thanks all — this feels actionable for tomorrow's kickoff. :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks — posting the one-pager link in 15m.
